title: TabaPay closes $155m financing; agrees to buy a bank
summary: Money movement platform TabaPay is set to buy a Denver-based bank after securing $155 million in strategic growth financing led by FTV Capital.
content: Money movement platform TabaPay has successfully closed $155 million in strategic growth financing. Following this major funding round led by FTV Capital, the company has also agreed to acquire a Denver-based bank to further expand its operations and strengthen its presence in the financial services sector.

title: Amazon shopping assistant now helps users check if a message is a scam
summary: Amazon has unveiled a new tool in the fight against fraudsters, enabling US customers to ask Alexa for Shopping to verify whether a message, email, phone call, or text actually came from the retail giant.
content: Amazon has introduced a new feature allowing US customers to use its Alexa shopping assistant to verify if messages, emails, phone calls, or texts genuinely originated from the retail giant. This tool aims to help consumers combat fraudsters and protect themselves against deceptive communications by providing a quick way to authenticate suspicious outreach claiming to be from Amazon.
